operating_notes.text: Fire on 20 April 2026 in the CDU heat exchanger circuit of HPCL Rajasthan Refinery Limited (HRRL), an HPCL joint venture; CDU, VDU and other CDU-section units isolated and reported structurally safe, with no loss of life or injury.
The Prime Minister's scheduled dedication of the HRRL refinery on 21 April 2026 was postponed as a precaution; a revised date is to be announced.
FY26 average GRM was US $8.79/bbl vs US $5.74/bbl, before SAED and Road & Infrastructure Cess on exports.
FY26 crude throughput 26.04 MMT vs 25.27 MMT; domestic market sales 48.53 MMT vs 47.29 MMT.
Cumulative unrecognised negative LPG buffer ₹12,798.67 Cr at 31 March 2026; ₹3,300 Cr of ₹7,920 Cr MoPNG compensation recognised in FY26.
H1 crude throughput was 12.72 MMT vs 13.23 MMT in H1 FY26.
Cumulative unrecognised negative LPG buffer stood at ₹18,048.82 Cr at 30 September 2026.

timeline.summary: 21 Apr 2026: HPCL disclosed a fire on 20 April in the CDU section of JV HPCL Rajasthan Refinery; units isolated and safe, no injuries, PM's refinery dedication postponed, impact prima facie not material.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹123,693.38 Cr (+4.4% YoY), net profit ₹6,065.26 Cr (+77.6% YoY).
Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited shared the audio recording link for its Conference Call held on May 13, 2026, at 02:00 PM (IST) via **Rakesh Kumar Singh**, Company Secretary.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹139,113.5 Cr (+26.0% YoY), net profit ₹3,625.22 Cr (-6.1% YoY).
Hindustan Petroleum Corporation published its investor presentation ahead of the Q2FY27 earnings call on October 22, 2026.
Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited forwarded link to audio recording of conference call held on 23 October 2026.
